`final class VulkanShader`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Shader`](/reference/bridges/shader/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan.render.shader` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [VulkanShader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/render/shader/VulkanShader.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

A shader of Vulkan: the two stages compiled to SPIR-V, with their descriptor set layout and pipeline layout.

## Description

A stage that does not compile prints the error of shaderc and leaves the shader inactive, without throwing.

## Learn more

- [What it is made of](/build/backends/vulkan/#what-it-is-made-of)
- [Shader translation](/build/shader-translation/)
